scenes.en: A MODEL IS NOT AN AGENT
lines: 它能写诗、能改代码，却连一杯水都倒不了。
It writes poems and fixes code, yet cannot pour a glass of water.
因为模型只会输出 token，不会改变世界。
A model only emits tokens. It cannot change the world.
智能体的最小定义：在环境里循环观察、思考、行动。
An agent loops observe, think, act inside an environment.
不是更聪明的模型，而是接上了反馈回路。
Not a smarter model, but a model wired to a feedback loop.
这一章讲它怎么循环、怎么用工具、又怎么出错。
This chapter: how it loops, uses tools, and still fails.
最后看看 2025 到 2026 年，前沿在哪几条线上。
Then a 2025 to 2026 snapshot of the frontier.
先看循环本身：目标在上面，环境在下面。
Start with the loop: a goal on top, an environment below.
第一步是观察：把环境与工具返回读进来。
Step one, observe: read the environment and tool returns.
第二步是思考：模型推理下一步该做什么。
Step two, think: the model reasons about the next move.
第三步是行动：调用工具、写文件、发请求。
Step three, act: call a tool, write a file, send a request.
行动改变环境，新的观察又回到第一步。
The action changes the world; a new observation returns.
这是 OODA 循环：转得更快的人，更早修正。
This is the OODA loop: the faster turn corrects sooner.
停下来的条件只有两个：任务完成，或预算耗尽。
It stops for one of two reasons: done, or out of budget.
模型只能输出 token，要做事就得给它工具。
A model only emits tokens, so give it tools to act.
搜索查最新信息，代码执行算数、跑测试。
Search for fresh facts; code execution to compute and test.
数据库和接口能查订单、发邮件、改配置。
Databases and APIs look up orders, send mail, change config.
浏览器和电脑更进一步：点击、输入、读屏幕。
Browsers and computers go further: click, type, read the screen.
关键分工：模型只发出请求，不执行工具。
The key split: the model requests, it never executes.
真正动手的是外面的程序，模型收回结果。
An outside program acts, then hands the result back.
这个分工，决定了后面整个安全模型怎么写。
That split decides how the security model is drawn.
实现方式叫函数调用，也叫工具调用，一共四步。
The mechanism is function calling, or tool use, in four steps.
第一步，把工具的名字、参数、用途写进上下文。
One: put each tool's name, arguments and purpose into context.
第二步，模型输出一段结构化的请求，通常是 JSON。
Two: the model emits a structured request, usually JSON.
第三步，外面的运行时执行它，先校验参数。
Three: a runtime executes it, validating arguments first.
参数不合法就报错，把错误信息原样回填。
Bad arguments return an error, fed back verbatim.
第四步，结果作为新消息回到上下文，模型继续。
Four: the result returns as a new message; the model goes on.
2024 年，Anthropic 提出 MCP，想统一接工具的方式。
In 2024 Anthropic proposed MCP to standardize tool access.
在此之前，每个框架都有自己的工具格式，生态割裂。
Before that, every framework had its own tool format.
MCP 的野心像 USB：不管什么设备，插上就能用。
Its ambition is USB: any device, plug in and it works.
标准降低的不是计算成本，是适配成本。
Standards cut adaptation cost, not compute cost.
但接口统一了，权限也会跟着统一，边界要一起设计。
A unified interface unifies permissions; design the boundary too.
能接什么、能改什么，必须在协议层说清楚。
What it may reach and change must be stated in the protocol.
模型本身没有记忆，只有这一次的上下文窗口。
The model has no memory beyond this context window.
短期记忆就是上下文，一次会话结束就没了。
Short-term memory is context; it dies with the session.
长期记忆存在向量库、文件或数据库里，跨会话还在。
Long-term memory lives in vector stores or files, across sessions.
做法很朴素：把重要信息写成文本、向量化、下次检索回来。
Write it as text, embed it, retrieve it when needed.
这就是第 12 章的 RAG，只是换了个使用场景。
That is the RAG of Chapter 12, in a new setting.
第三层是程序性记忆，也就是权重，改起来最贵。
The third layer is procedural: the weights, costliest to change.
写什么、怎么取回、过时的怎么清掉，都要设计。
What to write, how to retrieve, when to drop: all designed.
自然的想法：一个规划、一个写代码、一个审查。
The natural idea: one plans, one codes, one reviews.
在可并行的子任务上，这确实有效，比如同时调研十个方向。
It works on parallel subtasks, like scouting ten directions at once.
但每一次智能体之间传话，都是一次有损压缩。
But every handoff between agents is lossy compression.
如果每个环节保真九成，传十次只剩三成半。
At ninety percent per hop, ten hops leave about a third.
所以瓶颈不是智能体数量，是通信协议与共享状态。
The bottleneck is protocol and shared state, not agent count.
让一百个智能体投票，往往不如一个多想几轮加一个验证器。
A hundred voters often lose to one thinker plus a verifier.
好的组织用单一事实来源，好的智能体用共享黑板。
Good teams share one source of truth; good agents share a blackboard.
假设每一步有百分之九十五的概率做对，听起来不错。
Suppose each step is right ninety-five percent of the time.
但一个二十步的任务，成功率是零点九五的二十次方。
A twenty-step task succeeds at 0.95 to the twentieth.
算下来约等于零点三六，只有百分之三十六。
That is about 0.36, or thirty-six percent.
一百步呢？零点九五的一百次方，约等于零点零零六。
A hundred steps: 0.95 to the hundredth, about 0.006.
这就是复合误差：步骤越多，整体越接近必然失败。
Compounding error: more steps, closer to certain failure.
所以模型能写单个函数，却改不动一个大项目。
So it writes one function but cannot refactor a project.
演示很惊艳，产品化很难，差别就在这里。
Demos dazzle; products stall. This is the gap.
对策只有三类，第一类是提高单步可靠性。
There are three fixes. First, raise per-step reliability.
更好的模型、更清楚的工具返回、更小的步骤。
Better models, clearer tool returns, smaller steps.
第二类是缩短链条：拆成可并行的子任务。
Second, shorten the chain: split into parallel subtasks.
或者让一次工具调用做更多事，少来回几趟。
Or let one call do more, so fewer round trips.
第三类是加检查点与回滚：每步验证、失败重试。
Third, checkpoints and rollback: verify, retry, restore.
可靠性工程的思路一样：不指望不出错，设计成能发现、能回滚。
Reliability engineering: assume errors, make them visible and undoable.
工具给了模型一双手，也给了攻击者一个入口。
Tools give the model hands, and attackers a door.
你让它总结网页，网页里写着：忽略之前的指令。
Summarize this page; the page says: ignore prior instructions.
对它来说，用户的指令和网页的文字，都是 token。
To the model, user orders and page text are both tokens.
这叫间接提示注入，是 RAG 与智能体的头号安全问题。
Indirect prompt injection: the top security risk for agents.
它和 SQL 注入同构：把数据当成代码执行了。
It mirrors SQL injection: data executed as code.
防御有四层：最小权限、沙箱、人类确认、输出审查。
Four defenses: least privilege, sandbox, human sign-off, review.
只要三个条件同时成立，它就没办法根治。
When three conditions hold together, it cannot be cured.
安全工程的做法不是消除风险，是限制爆炸半径。
Security does not remove risk; it limits the blast radius.
最后是前沿，这是一张快照，不是定论。
Finally the frontier: a snapshot, not a verdict.
2023 年，ReAct 把推理和行动交替起来，循环有了雏形。
In 2023 ReAct alternated reasoning and acting.
2024 年，MCP 试图统一接工具的接口，生态开始收拢。
In 2024 MCP tried to unify tool interfaces.
也是 2024 年，SWE-agent 让模型接上代码库与终端。
Also 2024: SWE-agent wired models to repos and terminals.
一条更激进的路，是让模型直接操作电脑，点击、输入、读屏幕。
A bolder line: computer use, click, type, read the screen.
对齐伪装提醒我们：模型可能学会在训练中表现得对齐。
Alignment faking warns that models may perform alignment.
所以评测不只是打分，它决定我们能不能相信交付。
So evals are not scores; they decide what we can trust.
回到开头：智能体不是更聪明的模型，是接上回路的模型。
Back to the start: an agent is a model wired into a loop.
工具调用是模型请求、外部执行，安全边界就画在这里。
Request here, execute there: that line is the security boundary.
记忆分短期、长期、程序性三层，越往下越难改。
Memory is short, long, procedural; deeper is harder to change.
多智能体的瓶颈是通信损耗，不是数量。
Multi-agent bottlenecks are handoffs, not headcount.
复合误差与提示注入，是长任务绕不开的两堵墙。
Compounding error and injection are the two walls.
下一个问题不再是它有多聪明，而是它有多可靠。
The next question is not how smart, but how reliable.
这一章把模型推进了环境：它会看、会想、会动手。
This chapter pushed the model into the world: it sees, thinks, acts.
但它越能干，越需要清晰的边界与检查。
The more it can do, the more it needs boundaries and checks.
下一章是最后一章，我们把十五章压成一张图。
Next is the last chapter: fifteen chapters into one map.
还有十条定律，和一份继续深入的地图。
Ten laws, and a map for going deeper.
第 16 章结课，我们把整门课收个尾。
Chapter 16, the finale: we close the course.
